description.value: Clayburn Liquor Store is one of 13 Springs Group liquor store locations across British Columbia, carrying a staff-curated selection of craft beer, wine, and spirits. The store offers curbside pickup and delivery in addition to in-store shopping, and participates in the Springs Group VIP loyalty program redeemable across all chain locations. It is situated in Abbotsford in the Fraser Valley, a well-travelled cycling corridor.

address.value: Unit 150, 3033 Immel Street, Abbotsford, BC V2S 4L3

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 72m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Springs Group liquor store at 3033 Immel Street, Abbotsford, BC V2S 4L3 — not Chilliwack as the OSM community field indicates. Phone number (778) 360-2007 matches OSM exactly. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content; curbside/delivery ordering is confirmed via multiple website references.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the store's own website and address clearly place it in Abbotsford, BC — OSM community tag is incorrect.
